item.title: Vegetation increasingly controlled by atmospheric dryness rather than soil moisture
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 28 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02107-w

The influence of atmospheric dryness on vegetation has strengthened globally over the past four decades, while the influence of soil moisture has weakened, according to a machine learning analysis of satellite observations of vegetation greenness.
